title: Clearer limits for z-image output
summary:
z-image got explicit output limits, billing errors got their own status code, and support links got tidied up.

Updated z-image’s resolution math for 2× SPAN upscaling. Requests can specify outputs up to 2,359,296 pixels in total, with each dimension between 256 and 4096 pixels. Oversized requests are rejected instead of silently scaled down.

Insufficient Pollen balance now returns HTTP 402, alongside exhausted API key budgets; HTTP 403 is reserved for access denied. Model Monitor also separates billing and access-denied counts and excludes 402 responses from health calculations.

Removed donation links from the README and funding configuration. The support section now directs readers to Enter for an API key, and a legacy text-model wrapper no longer turns model errors into donation requests.
